payload.body: FYI from vc: ISSUE:0003 gained one design point: on macOS, ccusage use in shared mode also sets launchd's CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR (launchctl setenv), so Claude Code started from GUI apps follows the active account, and doctor checks it. New ISSUE:0005: hv's Claude Usage fork (~/Devel/forks/claudecodeusage, upstream PR #15). Who builds it and when is hv's call, so it is not in your queue yet.
